newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's NBH confirms relief to run-hit Postabank.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's NBH confirms relief to run-hit Postabank.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) confirmed on Friday that it granted a temporary exemption from the placing of obligatory reserves with the NBH, to Postabank Rt, which was hit by panic withdrawals recently.

"We freed Postabank's reserves for the request of the bank," NBH president Gyorgy Suranyi told a news conference. "The managers of the bank must have asked for this to improve Postabank's liquidity following withdrawals of deposits."
The daily Nepszabadsag said on Thursday that the exemption of Postabank, Hungary's second largest commercial bank, is valid until April 15 and frees some 20 billion forints at the bank.
Depositors withdrew around 24 billion forints three weeks ago from Postabank in a four-day-long rumour-triggered panic wave.
